clips.title: The story
paras: At the Pools of Arlithrien, the Filled Tourmaline Phial carries moonwell water for Corithras Moonrage. Its waters help him watch the health and balance of the growing World Tree.

The Filled Tourmaline Phial draws water from a moonwell southeast of the road to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. Reaching the shrine has grown dangerous as the Gnarlpine furbolgs, once peaceful neighbors, turn violently mad. Corithras Moonrage asks travelers to brave the hostile groves and bring back the water. He hopes it will help him find the deepening corruption unsettling the land.
